tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer holding a valid German residence and work permit, currently based in Karlsruhe.

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Walk with Natalia!
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining commercetools. With over 5 years of professional experience building and extending large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep backend expertise in Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs.

bullets.label: Backend & API Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, developing and exposing OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Maintained core e-commerce modules including Promotions Engine, Product Catalog, and Order Management (OMS) for high-traffic enterprise platforms.

bullets.label: Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized data pipelines using Hotfolders, DataHub, and custom integrations to synchronize product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: Performance & Quality
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, performed code reviews, and supported production troubleshooting within agile teams.

cover_en.gap: While my background is centered on SAP Commerce Cloud rather than native commercetools infrastructure, I am very keen to learn new headless e-commerce architectures and platform tools quickly.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to join commercetools to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend experience in Java, Spring, and API integrations to your innovative digital commerce solutions, while growing my expertise in modern cloud-native architectures.
tailoring.motivation_short: Looking to leverage 5+ years of e-commerce backend and API development experience in a dynamic team at commercetools.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am a backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience in Java, Spring, and REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am very interested in commercetools and available from Dec 16, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for [Post] Walk with Natalia! – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the [Post] Walk with Natalia! position. With over 5 years of backend e-commerce experience in Java, Spring, and REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to your team.

I hold a valid German work permit, am based in Karlsruhe, and can start on 16 December 2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
